verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a case management review flow: risk evaluation can route a transaction to review, and a reviewer accepts or rejects the case in the Customer Area. That is the product's own review-queue capability, but none of the team-workflow elements the story asks for are evidenced. missing for 10: case assignment to specific reviewers, escalation paths, SLA tracking, a decision audit trail showing who approved what and why, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why

citations.quote: A reviewer then accesses the case in the Customer Area and accepts or rejects the transaction.
The risk evaluation reaches a decision that results in an action to block, allow, or review the transaction.
